title: Resolution urging Albany to require consent before sterilization procedures
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.3357/A.1582, which would bar health care providers from performing sterilization procedures without the informed consent of the person being sterilized. The bill would end the practice of guardians, health care proxies or other third parties consenting to sterilization on someone else's behalf, except when needed to preserve life or prevent serious harm to physical health. It would also allow people with disabilities to use supported decision-making agreements when deciding on sterilization, without the supporter making the decision for them.
